# migadu_identity (Resource)

Manages a Migadu mailbox identity.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "migadu_identity" "example" {
  domain_name        = "example.com"
  mailbox_local_part = "alice"
  local_part         = "alice.work"
  name               = "Alice (Work)"
  password           = var.identity_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String) The domain this identity belongs to.
- `local_part` (String) The local part of this identity.
- `mailbox_local_part` (String) The local part of the parent mailbox.
- `name` (String) The display name of this identity.

### Optional

- `password` (String, Sensitive) The identity password. Not read back from the API.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) The full identity address.
- `footer_active` (Boolean) Whether the email footer is active (inherited from mailbox).
- `footer_html_body` (String) HTML footer body (inherited from mailbox).
- `footer_plain_body` (String) Plain-text footer body (inherited from mailbox).
- `may_access_imap` (Boolean) Whether IMAP access is allowed (inherited from mailbox).
- `may_access_managesieve` (Boolean) Whether ManageSieve access is allowed (inherited from mailbox).
- `may_access_pop3` (Boolean) Whether POP3 access is allowed (inherited from mailbox).
- `may_receive` (Boolean) Whether this identity may receive (inherited from mailbox).
- `may_send` (Boolean) Whether this identity may send (inherited from mailbox).
